verdict.rationale: Zero's MCP server documents deleting and bulk-deleting emails, and self-hosting lets users run the app themselves. That covers only one slice of the story: user-initiated deletion of mailbox items. Zero says it caches users' emails in Durable Objects and R2, but nothing documents retention settings or purging of that cached copy. Missing for 10: retention policy/period controls, account or data-export/erasure controls, purging of server-side cached email copies (Durable Object/R2), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: gives users the power to **self-host** their own email app
